definition: to be the source of pain
description: A young footballer in a white and blue striped shirt sits on a bench in a changing room with his leg pulled up. Low on his shin is a big dark purple mark, and he screws up his face and sucks in his breath as he touches it. A team-mate crouches beside him, points at the mark and winces too, then hands him a blue ice pack. The player presses the ice pack against his shin, flinches and grits his teeth, then holds it there and breathes out slowly while the pain settles.

en.question: Why is the sitting player holding ice?

de.answer: Er hält es, weil sein Bein wehtut.
de.question: Warum hält der sitzende Spieler Eis?

es.answer: Lo está sosteniendo porque le duele la pierna.
es.question: ¿Por qué está sosteniendo hielo el jugador sentado?

fr.answer: Il la tient parce qu'il a mal à la jambe.
fr.question: Pourquoi le joueur assis tient-il de la glace ?
